items.title: Unramifiedness or local quasi-finiteness of a cover forces the same property for the diagonal
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.work: Stacks Project — Morphisms of Algebraic Stacks
items.source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file stacks-morphisms.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
items.difficulty_reason: The counted statement shows that if a covering algebraic space over a stack has unramified, respectively locally quasi-finite projections from its fibre product, then the diagonal of the stack has the same property (author lemma at source lines 1116-1126, label lemma-properties-covering-imply-diagonal). The proof (source lines 1128-1156) reduces the diagonal to the canonical morphism from the fibre product of the cover with itself to the square of the cover, and applies the permanence statements for morphisms of algebraic spaces to the two projections (proof lines 1132-1155). The identification of the pulled-back diagonal with that canonical morphism is the content. H3.
